status: Questions for a future visit; no findings or fieldwork claimed
purpose: Keep the desk-research edition honest and make later community contributions specific.

questions.ask: Which designs, colour names and meanings does this maker use? Who taught them? How do choices differ for wearing, gifting and sale?
questions.avoid: Treating one explanation as a community-wide code.

questions.ask: Where does the base cloth come from now, what work goes into an order, and what payment does the maker actually receive?
questions.avoid: Inferring earnings from shop prices or announced programmes.

questions.ask: What does the wearer call this piece, who made it, and when do they choose to wear it?
questions.avoid: Assigning identity, marital status or ritual meaning from appearance.

questions.ask: Which crops and foods are used in this household now? How are seeds shared and produce taken to market?
questions.avoid: Extending historical or regional reports to every household.

questions.ask: Which languages do children and teachers use, and which actual books or writing systems are in use?
questions.avoid: Assuming a published primer or devised alphabet is adopted locally.

questions.ask: Who is the singer, what is the song called locally, when may it be sung, and how would the singer explain its words?
questions.avoid: Publishing recordings, translations or names without the contributor’s agreed use.

questions.ask: Which passages and images feel recognisable to participants, and what needs correction or another voice?
questions.avoid: Calling one person’s review approval by the entire community.

record_for_each_contribution: Name and preferred identification, if agreed
Permission for the particular quotation, photograph or recording
What is personal experience and what the speaker describes more broadly
